category_title: Seventh-grade students in an urban classroom exhibiting frequent off-task behavior
scenario_title: Social Studies Map Activity and Independent Work
minimal_context: The student is seated at a table with peers in a social studies class, working on a map activity with their journal open.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open your journals, make sure your pencils are sharpened, and begin working independently on your map activity at your tables.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: See? My notebook is out, too. Am I doing a good job on my map?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: We need to go back to how she was doing class. You aren't saying anything when we do it right.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Don't worry about that right now, and don't talk to your neighbors. Just stay in your seat and finish the map.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up from the table and stops working on the map) I'm not doing this. (Walks over to another group to start a nonacademic conversation and begins eating a snack)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please open your journals, make sure your pencils are sharpened, and begin working independently on your map activity at your tables.

STUDENT: See? My notebook is out, too. Am I doing a good job on my map?

TUTOR: Just keep working on it.

STUDENT: We need to go back to how she was doing class. You aren't saying anything when we do it right.

TUTOR: Don't worry about that right now, and don't talk to your neighbors. Just stay in your seat and finish the map.

STUDENT: (Stands up from the table and stops working on the map) I'm not doing this. (Walks over to another group to start a nonacademic conversation and begins eating a snack)

task.content: Completion of tasks or cooperation with peers on an academic project, such as a map-related activity, or having his or her journal opened and a pencil sharpened
task.learning_goal: Staying in one's seat and completing work

context.environment: Seventh-grade social studies class at an urban high school
context.social_setting: Students seated at six tables, working in groups of five to six or independently

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher returned to reprimanding the students and paying attention to their negative behavior, or tried to 'don't' the students into submission
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Immediate decrease of on-task behavior, engaging in off-task behavior which included nonacademic conversations, unrelated reading, hitting, sleeping, or eating
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Noticed when the BSPs disappeared during the withdrawal—and did not like it

behavior_patterns.condition: When faced with disruptive behavior and the teacher responds by increasing their use of verbal reprimands
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Getting out of the seat, standing up, running, and moving chairs, as well as verbal ones, such as talking to a peer, speaking out of turn, or making inappropriate noises
